## Candidate States

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document.

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

df <- read_excel("carnes_legislators.xlsx")

View(df)

df %>%
  filter(!is.na(YearBorn)) %>%
  group_by(StateAbbrev) %>%
  summarise(n_legislators = n())

#making state_counts own data frame
state_counts <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(YearBorn)) %>%
  count(StateAbbrev, name = "n_legislators")

#saving as csv
write.csv(state_counts, "state_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
